meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: Claude 会去 cmem.ai 上搜索你的历史记忆，先做宽泛检索，再用更具体的词语精查，最后用自然语言总结相关过往观察，必要时给出时间戳，不会直接输出原始记录。
howto.when: 当用户说 'search memory'、'check claude-mem' 或 'what did we do last session' 等，或想了解某个项目、决策的过往上下文时触发。

say.text: 我们上次会话做了什么？
say.note: Claude 会去查过往记录并给你总结。

say.text: 你对我提到的预算方案还记得什么？
say.note: Claude 会搜索与预算方案相关的历史观察。

say.text: 查一下 claude-mem 里关于登录报错的记录
say.note: Claude 会查找该错误的过往记录。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude searches the user's cmem.ai memory, first broadly, then with specific terms, and gives a natural-language summary of relevant past observations, quoting timestamps when asked, without dumping raw records.
howto.when_en: Triggered by phrases like 'search memory', 'check claude-mem' or 'what did we do last session', or when the user wants prior context about a project, decision, etc.

say_en.text: What did we do last session?
say_en.note: Claude pulls up past observations and summarizes.

say_en.text: What do you remember about the budget proposal?
say_en.note: Claude searches memory for related observations.

say_en.text: Check claude-mem for records about the login error.
say_en.note: Claude looks up past observations about that error.
